nodes.title: Phase 29C hybrid AI production integration
nodes.value: Production requires OpenRouter for text/reasoning and direct Gemini for persisted plan recognition. Historical direct-Gemini plan intake passed for PNG, JPEG, and PDF, but the current rotated Gemini credential fails authentication. The canonical Phase 29C live gate also fails because OpenRouter returns request_rejected. No replacement primary was selected; Nemotron Ultra remains fallback after repeated successful standalone compatibility probes.
provenance: pnpm validate on phase29, 2026-09-27: 830 Python, 26 web, 1 contract

nodes.title: Phase 29C/29E NVIDIA NIM-only AI runtime
nodes.value: All six production-profile runtime switches use nvidia_nim with NVIDIA_API_KEY only. Ultra is the sole active text primary and there is no automatic cross-model fallback. One same-model retry is allowed only for unavailable/timeout within the total deadline. Plan recognition remains Nano Omni with local bounded PDF-to-PNG rendering. Manual evidence is Ultra RequirementDraft PASS_LIVE and Nano Omni PNG PASS_LIVE; Lightning timed out, JPEG was unavailable, and rendered-PDF inference is not qualified. The canonical live gate inventories the two active IDs, requires exact response-model provenance, and stops on the first failure. AI outputs remain advisory and confirmation-required. OpenRouter and Gemini adapters are legacy/inactive. Production entitlement remains human-action-blocked.

nodes.title: Phase 29D PhonePe and payment atomicity
nodes.value: PhonePe Standard Checkout v2 is launch-capable locally with persisted checkout intent, authoritative provider-status reconciliation, and atomic event/order/entitlement settlement. Replay, duplicate, stale-state, and concurrent settlement paths fail closed. Recurring products remain unavailable until genuine AutoPay exists. Live PhonePe, database, backup/restore, and deployment qualification remain outstanding.
provenance: Phase 29D local checkpoint: 940 Python tests, 32 web tests, Ruff PASS, mypy PASS across 208 files, Phase 29C and Phase 29D gates PASS

nodes.value: Vastudraw/Codex development uses GPT-5.6 Sol Medium for all agents and skills by default. Model or reasoning escalation requires explicit user approval. The Model Router routes roles, workflow, context, tests, reviewers, and human-review conditions, not model family or effort.
